properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued for Norfolk, Chesapeake, and Virginia Beach until 8:00 PM EDT.
properties.description: Heavy rain is causing flash flooding in Norfolk and Chesapeake. Water may rise 3 feet near roads and low areas.
properties.instruction: Move to higher ground now. Do not drive across flooded roads. Avoid VA-168 near Exit 12 until 8:00 PM EDT. Call 911 only for life-threatening emergencies.
properties.demo_notice: Synthetic demo fixture using the NWS CAP schema. It is not an active warning.
